text:
Harper: Quick heads-up  were launching the benchmark + webinar next Wed. Need: X teaser thread that stitches to signup, a LinkedIn short + article, hero assets (ratio checklist), and SDR routing for signups. Who can own what?

Zoe: I can own X scheduling + stitch. Thinking: 4-part thread: hook metric, one methodology tweet, short clip/GIF, CTA -> signup. Will prep 3 variant hooks (audience, technical, cost-savings). ETA copy by EOD.

Kian: I'll draft the LinkedIn article and a TL;DR post. Article ~700 words, emphasize why benchmarks matter for ops teams. Also will prepare a 1-paragraph version for LinkedIn share.

Maddie: Assets list requested: hero-1200x628.png, hero-square-1080.png, clip-9s.mp4 (9:16 & 16:9), gif-loop-2s.gif, header-x-1500x500.png. Uploading to /Marketing/BenchWebinar/Assets and will share link.

Harper: SDR routing: signups -> /leads/webinar-bench-2025, tag=organic_social, owner=webinar-sdrs. Include UTM: utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=bench_webinar_2025. @SDR Bot can you create rule webinar_bench_route -> Webinar SDR queue, priority=high?

SDR Bot: Created rule webinar_bench_route -> Webinar SDR queue, priority=high, tags=[organic_social, webinar]. :white_check_mark:

Zoe: Draft hooks (preview):
A) "New benchmark: 3x throughput at 1/3 unit cost. TL;DR + webinar link."
B) "Under the hood: batching + KV caching cut ops 40%  details in the webinar."
C) "Latency wins you can measure  watch our demo and Q&A."

Zoe: Proposed posting cadence:
- Wed 09:00 PT: X teaser thread (Variant A)
- Wed 09:10 PT: LinkedIn short post + link to article
- Wed 09:30 PT: LinkedIn article publish (Kian)
- Wed 48h after: Follow-up Q&A thread (live")

Maddie: Uploaded assets: hero-1200x628.png, hero-1080.png, clip-9x16.mp4, clip-16x9.mp4, gif-loop-2s.gif, header-x-1500x500.png -> https://drive.google.com/drive/fake_link_bench

Harper: Engagement plan: seed comments for first 4 hours, pin top reply with signup link, escalate demo asks to SDRs. @Maddie can you draft 3 seed comments per variant?

Maddie: Seed comments examples:
1) "This one changed how we think about token budgets  join the webinar for configs."
2) "Anyone curious about multi-tenant results? We'll cover it live."
3) "Report + scripts linked in the webinar sign-up."

Harper: SDR quick playbook (pasteable):
- <30m: Send intro email with report link + 2 tailored bullets, CTA to schedule demo.
- <24h: If MQL, move to demo pipeline and notify AE.
- After 3 no-reply attempts: tag nurture, enroll in drip.
Include instruction: reference utm_campaign and source in CRM.

Zoe: sched-bot reminder: use /schedule-post to queue to Buffer and include utm params + ab_test metadata if we want to A/B CTA text. Also enable auto-pin on first reply.

sched-bot: Reminder set: /schedule-post recommended and auto-pin option available.

Harper: Final asks: Zoe queue X thread + stitch clip and add UTM; Kian finish article and hand off preview; Maddie confirm file sizes and seed drafts; SDR Bot rule good. We'll reconvene Wed 08:30 PT for pre-launch checklist. :rocket:
